digest.component_or_area: fsck snapshot rebuild and event compaction
propositions: rebuild_snapshot_from_full_log silently replays an incomplete event log when prior snapshots contain folded events deleted before the Jul-7 compaction fix, causing orphaned history to be lost and ticket status to regress
fsck --repair and --repair-snapshots mutate the ticket store even when --dry-run is specified, preventing safe preview of broad legacy rebuilds
505 live tickets have snapshots citing source_event_uuids with no corresponding files on disk, vulnerable to the same data loss if a rebuild is triggered
rebuild must fail closed and refuse to write lossy snapshots when the event log is incomplete, surfacing affected tickets for human triage instead
deleted source events must be restored from git history as .retired files to complete the log before rebuild is attempted, making the repair auto-executable rather than permanently stuck
the existing safety policy guards which orphan type triggers a rebuild but not the blast radius once triggered, allowing order-sensitive events to be rewritten from incomplete logs
